name: Lipschitz MLP Regularization
definition: A regularization technique applied to the scene manipulator MLP to ensure that interpolated latent codes yield plausible, visually natural deformations by bounding the Lipschitz constant of the network.
summary: Lipschitz MLP Regularization ensures plausible deformations by bounding the Lipschitz constant via trainable layer-wise constants, distinguishing itself from standard methods by adapting smoothness during optimization.
